messages:
maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4328 - model-catalog: clarify batching behavior for quantized variants + bench link. Need quick review before Friday deploy.
kevin: looking now. main question: do we call this 'auto-batching' or 'continuous batching'? pick one and stick.
maya: I used 'continuous batching' to match runtime docs but can switch. Also added a short note about seq_len cap for 4bit quant (ZephyrX).
sara: seq_len cap needs concrete numbers. can you add table or example? reviewers will nit if it's vague.
maya: added snippet: ```yaml
model: zephyrx-4bit
max_sequence: 2048
bench: throughput: 450 tokens/s (p4d)
```
eli: bench numbers look high compared to my runs. what was batch size and prompt length? include bench methodology.
maya: bench command in PR description: `./bench/run --model zephyrx-4bit --seq 512 --batch 8 --tokenize --runs 30` added link to raw results: https://storage.redwood/bench/zephyrx-4bit/2026-03-15.json
kevin: ok add a short 'how we measured' sentence in model card + mention 'results vary with batch/seq'. then lgtm.
sara: also update SDK example for streaming generate to show fallback to fp16 model when quantized coldstart occurs.
maya: pushed SDK snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate('zephyrx-4bit', prompt='...')
# SDK will fallback to 'zephyrx-fp16' if coldstart latency > 250ms
```
doc-bot: Lint check: docs/model_catalog/zephyrx-4bit.md - trailing whitespace on line 42 (fixing auto).
maya: thanks doc-bot. will squash lint fix into PR.
eli: small nit: change 'coldstart' to 'initialization latency' for clarity.
maya: done. thanks. approving after CI passes. assigning to @kevin for final merge.
kevin: :thumbsup: merging after green. small followups can be new PRs.
